questions.question: What is the primary role of the CSS @supports at-rule?
options: To perform feature queries that test browser support for a CSS property before applying styles
questions.explanation: @supports tests whether the browser supports a specified property and value pair, enabling progressive enhancement.

questions.question: Which build tool automatically handles adding and removing vendor prefixes (like -webkit-) based on target browser data?
questions.explanation: Autoprefixer parses CSS and automatically appends vendor prefixes according to CanIUse browser market share data.

questions.question: Which website is the universal industry standard for checking browser support tables for CSS features?
questions.explanation: CanIUse.com provides up-to-date browser compatibility tables for modern front-end web technologies.

questions.question: Which vendor prefix historically targeted the WebKit engine used by Apple Safari and modern iOS browsers?
questions.explanation: -webkit- is the vendor prefix for the WebKit layout engine powering Safari and iOS browsers.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of a modern CSS Reset or Normalize stylesheet?
options: To erase the entire HTML file
To eliminate inconsistent default margins, paddings, and font sizes across different browser engines
To prevent users from opening DevTools
To force desktop resolutions on mobile
questions.explanation: A CSS reset neutralizes browser user-agent inconsistencies, establishing a consistent starting baseline across all browsers.
